== Title ==
<span lang="ja">炎の壁</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">パイロットが搭乗している自分のＡＴ－ＡＴが位置にいるなら、同じ位置か隣接する屋外位置にいる兵員／トルーパーを好きなだけ目標として選ぶ。運命数を引く。運命数＞目標とした兵員／トルーパーの人数なら、それらは全員即座にロストする。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ウォーカーにかかれば歩兵部隊など数秒でまるごと灰と化してしまう。反乱軍の兵員たちはこの苛烈な弾幕を“炎の壁”として恐れている。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Wall Of Fire.

'''Lore''' — If a walker hits them, infantry units and the like are turned to ash in seconds. Rebel troops fear this fierce barrage as the "wall of fire."

'''Game text''' — If you have a piloted AT-AT at a location, target as many troopers as you want at the same location or an adjacent exterior location. Draw destiny. If destiny is greater than the number of troopers targeted, they are all immediately lost.

Title is 炎の壁. Game text targets 兵員／トルーパー rather than troopers only, and uses 位置 for site.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-walloffire-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Wall Of Fire]].</ref>
